status: DRAFT — host-only, not frozen, NO BOARD RULING (owner 2026-09-05: B1 authorised to the pre-board package; the next board contact needs its own explicit ruling)

prereg.note: null = DRAFT: host/b1_runner.py refuses to run until the owner's freeze writes the hash here

instrument.psoracle_role: archived, read-only: the host stack (reader, console, notary relay, collector, validators, rate report) and the carrier are used as committed; verified against manifests/claimb_round1prime_instrument_pins.json before any import
instrument.successor_note: the B1 image is a versioned SUCCESSOR of the instrument's two-operator image: the same wire protocol (rel-v4), the same transactions, the same BSP, the instrument's own p3_derive/p3_rectx/p3_pull byte for byte (firmware/b1/IMPORT.json); the search replaced by the cartographer; loop_record 1.2.0 (+carto), app_identity 1.4.0 (+carto_version, universe_sha256, probe_budget). The instrument's L6 calibrations do NOT transfer to it: a new image needs its own compatibility review and, if a budget is ever derived from a rate, its own calibration (roadmap §6)

image.note: the binary is not committed (bsp/out is gitignored, as the instrument's is); it is rebuilt byte-identically by firmware/b1/bsp/build.sh and hash-checked by the runner. board_ready is false until the owner's compatibility review and freeze

universe.note: the cartographer receives the 292 addresses (P3_WHITELIST, genome-bit order) and the safety class; local_map.json is the ground truth HELD BACK from the executable (leakage guards: tests/test_b1_leakage.py)

cartographer.source: firmware/b1/b1_carto.c (pure unit; host twin firmware/b1/b1_twin.c; Python reference host/b1_carto.py)

seeds.rule: the first 4 bytes, big-endian, of sha256(b'b1-cartography|' + psoracle_commit) — advanced by 4 bytes while the value is in `excluded`

excluded.rule: the B1 master seed is none of these

audit.note: every record's readout is served and host-verified: in B1 every readout is the data

protocol.controls: seq-1 forced REC-retry and SIGNREQ-retry controls armed (flags bit4, bit5)

rulings_binding.note: image_sha256 is the B1 image's; prereg_sha256 is B1's frozen preregistration; b1_manifest_sha256 is THIS file as committed at the freeze
